_comment: Ramp themes: WHO lives on the dressed airfields. Weighted lists [ref, weight] keep mixes realistic (a Red Flag ramp is mostly USAF with a few visitors, not an even split). Era-gated: a theme only exists under its era. default marks the era/side fallback; map presets may override per side (e.g. Nevada blue = usaf - Nellis is an Air Force base, no random Hornets). Trucks/GSE stay era-side data in eras.json.

usaf.label: US Air Force
usaf.desc: CONUS/USAFE ramp - Vipers, Eagles, Hogs, heavies. No Navy paint.

red_flag.label: Red Flag exercise
red_flag.desc: Nellis surge ramp: USAF core + B-1/B-52 heavies, aggressor Vipers, Navy and allied visitors.

navy_marine.label: Navy / Marine Corps
navy_marine.desc: Shore-based NAS/MCAS ramp - Hornets, Tomcats, Harriers, Hawkeyes, Seahawks.

expeditionary.label: Joint expeditionary
expeditionary.desc: Deployed coalition mix - the classic forward-operating ramp.

vks.label: Russian VKS (frontal)
vks.desc: Fulcrums, Flankers, Fencers, Frogfoots with transport and AWACS support.

strategic.label: Long-Range Aviation
strategic.desc: Backfire/Bear bomber base with interceptor defense and tankers.

usafe.label: USAFE / US Air Force
usafe.desc: 1980s Air Force ramp - Phantoms, Eagles, Tigers, Herks on the Victor Alert line.

nato_allied.label: NATO allied wing
nato_allied.desc: Mixed alliance ramp - Phantoms alongside Tornados and Mirages.

navy.label: US Navy
navy.desc: Tomcat-era NAS ramp - F-14s, Vikings, Hawkeyes.

vvs.label: Soviet VVS (frontal)
vvs.desc: Fishbeds, Floggers, Fitters with An-26 hacks - the classic WP ramp.

pvo.label: Soviet PVO (air defense)
pvo.desc: Interceptor regiment - Foxbats and Foxhounds on alert rows.

raf.label: Royal Air Force
raf.desc: Spitfires and Mosquitos dispersed on a fighter station.

usaaf.label: US Army Air Forces
usaaf.desc: Mustangs and Thunderbolts with Havocs and Skytrains on the hardstands.

luftwaffe.label: Luftwaffe
luftwaffe.desc: 109s and 190s in revetments, a Ju 88 on the apron.
